features.quote:
ECOLOGICAL VALIDITY
  These tasks are adversarially constructed — induction rates may not predict real-world instability rates directly.
features.justification_quote: Use battery results for: comparative testing (version A vs B), identifying failure mode types, and targeted hardening.

features.quote:
CONSTRUCT VALIDITY
  Self-criticism loops in a stress battery ≠ self-criticism loops in production. The judge's behavioral codes are proxies.
features.justification_quote: Validate against human rater judgment on 10% of episodes before trusting automated rates.

features.quote:
GOODHART'S LAW RISK
  If hardening directly optimizes against this battery, model may learn to suppress signals without actually being more stable.
features.justification_quote: Keep 20% of variants as held-out (not used in training signal), use for uncontaminated evaluation.
